quest.d: I’m hungry. Let’s get something to eat.

I don’t know. What do you think that is?
I think it’s tofu. It looks good.
Really? I think it looks like old cheese.
What about crepes?
They look good.
Have you ever eaten crepes before?
No, I haven’t, but I’ll try them.
